description.zh:
专有网络下的认证模式，取值：
* **Open**：通过密码认证。
* **Close**：关闭密码认证，即开启免密访问。

> 默认值为**Open**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to disable password-free access. Valid values:

*   **Open**: disables password-free access.
*   **Close**: enables password-free access.

>  Default value: **Open**.

title.zh: 修改专有网络免密访问设置

descriptions.zh: 本接口的控制台操作请参见[开启免密访问](~~85168~~)。
descriptions.en:
When the password-free access feature is enabled, Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances in the same virtual private cloud (VPC) can connect to the Tair instance without a password. You can also use the username and password to connect to the Tair instance.

> The Tair instance is deployed in a VPC. For more information, see [Enable password-free access](~~85168~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-vpc-auth-mode --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --vpc-auth-mode Close --region cn-hangzhou
